title: Hedge funds on track for another stellar year on AI boom
excerpt: Global hedge funds are on track for another blockbuster year, as they look to surpass their returns from 2025 after an artificial intelligence boom buoyed fi...
content_html:
By Anirban Sen

NEW YORK, July 28 (Reuters) - Global hedge funds are on track for another blockbuster year, as they look to surpass their returns from 2025 after an artificial intelligence boom buoyed first-half performance for money managers across most investment strategies, according to a Goldman Sachs note sent to clients that ‌was seen by Reuters.

During the first six months of this year, hedge funds returned an average of 7%, well above the 10-year average of 4.1%, according ‌to the Goldman report. Those returns have been exceeded only twice, during the COVID years of 2020 and 2021, when market volatility boosted returns for fund managers. It marks the sixth consecutive half-year period in which hedge ​fund returns exceeded their long-term average.

"Hedge funds broadly have successfully pivoted through the AI complex in the last few years, adeptly shifting exposures through the 'picks and shovels' of the AI boom, moving from semis, to power & data centers, and in the last 12 months decisively towards memory stocks," Goldman wrote.

Demand from allocators, or investors who back hedge funds, has also surged during this year, amid a broadening flow of capital into the industry.

In a July survey of 341 hedge fund allocators overseeing more than $1.5 trillion invested in hedge funds, Goldman found nearly half of those investors planned ‌to increase their hedge fund exposure in the second half ⁠of 2026, while only 3% expected to reduce it. The bank said net demand for hedge funds reached a new record and remained well ahead of other asset classes across the alternative investments industry.

"The focus on ex-US strategies that became strongly evident following the 'Liberation Day' moment of April ⁠2025 seems to have slowed down, with allocators gradually returning towards North America-focused funds. That said, it still remains with the greatest proportion of allocators looking to decrease exposure," Goldman wrote.

Liberation Day is the name President Donald Trump gave to the day when he detailed sweeping global tariffs.

Institutional investors that were surveyed by Goldman reported average hedge fund portfolio returns of 7.3% in the first half, while ​private ​capital investors, including family offices and private banks, reported returns of 8.8%.

Every major hedge fund strategy brought ​in fresh capital during the first half – a first in five years. ‌Quantitative, or computer-driven, funds continued to attract strong new money, while multi-strategy funds posted their strongest inflow levels in five years.

content_html_zh:
作者：阿尼班·森

路透纽约 7 月 28 日 - 根据路透看到的高盛发给客户的一份报告，在人工智能繁荣提振了大多数投资策略的基金经理上半年业绩后，全球对冲基金有望迎来又一个轰动的一年，因为它们希望超越 2025 年以来的回报。

高盛报告显示，今年前六个月，对冲基金平均回报率为 7%，远高于 4.1% 的 10 年平均回报率。 这些回报率仅在 2020 年和 2021 年新冠疫情期间两次超过，当时市场波动提高了基金经理的回报率。 这标志着对冲基金回报率连续第六年超过长期平均水平。

高盛写道：“过去几年，对冲基金普遍成功地转向了人工智能综合体，通过人工智能繁荣的‘镐和铲’巧妙地转移了风险敞口，从半成品转向电力和数据中心，并在过去 12 个月果断转向内存股。”

今年，随着流入该行业的资本不断扩大，配置者或支持对冲基金的投资者的需求也激增。

高盛 7 月份对 341 家对冲基金投资超过 1.5 万亿美元的对冲基金配置者进行了调查，发现其中近一半的投资者计划在 2026 年下半年增加对冲基金敞口，而只有 3% 的投资者预计会减少。 该银行表示，对冲基金的净需求创下新纪录，并仍远远领先于另类投资行业的其他资产类别。

“在 2025 年 4 月的‘解放日’时刻之后，对美国以外的策略的关注似乎已经放缓，分配者逐渐回归以北美为重点的基金。 尽管如此，最大比例的配置者仍然希望减少风险敞口，”高盛写道。

解放日是唐纳德·特朗普总统在详细介绍全面的全球关税时给这一天起的名字。

高盛调查的机构投资者报告称，上半年对冲基金投资组合的平均回报率为 7.3%，而包括家族办公室和私人银行在内的私人资本投资者报告的回报率为 8.8%。

每项主要对冲基金策略都在上半年引入了新资本——这是五年来的第一次。 ‌定量或计算机驱动的基金继续吸引强劲的新资金，而多策略基金则录得五年来最强劲的流入水平。
